card.name: Sentence-ending points before new text
card.fires_on: Mostly the last word or punctuation mark of a heading or short warning, such as ONLY after FOR TOPICAL USE, or a period or exclamation mark ending a sentence. The next text is a new statement.

modes.label: End of caps warning
modes.description: The word ONLY or a final period closing an all-caps label or warning line.
modes.example: WARNING: FOR TOPICAL USE<< ONLY>>. DO NOT APPLY TO BROKEN SK

modes.label: Sentence or heading close
modes.description: A closing bracket or exclamation mark that ends a heading or sentence, just before the next sentence starts.
modes.example: Environment Canada says we throw away 4 million disposable diapers a day<<!>> Most of them go into landfills –

modes.label: Mid-clause linking word
modes.description: A small word like all, may or of in a label sentence about who or what is covered.
modes.example: Slight foaming of the product<< may>> be present upon reconstitution.

card.writes: It slightly favors words like our and company-voice terms (お客様, 저희) for the next text, which suggests a new first-person or promotional sentence.
card.plain: It fires at the end of a label heading or short warning, just before a new sentence starts.
